response.headers: optional object of lowercase allowlisted pagination header values

fleetQueryRules: GET only; one nonempty value per key; reject unknown keys, malformed escapes, encoded routes, fragments and traversal
cursorRules: When x-has-more=true, advance with x-next-before-created-at plus x-next-before-id-encoded (beforeIdEncoded query), falling back to x-next-before-id; advance even when a page body is empty after virtual-printer filtering
credentials: paired Agent credentials stay inside the CLI; no Authorization, Set-Cookie or secret response headers cross the desktop bridge
